Name: Detected points
Payload: numDetectedObj × 16 B: `x, y, z` (m), `doppler` (m/s), each float32

Name: Range profile
Payload: rangeFFTSize × uint16. Sum of log2 magnitudes over the receive antennas at zero Doppler, **Q9** (divide by 512 to get log2 units; multiply log2 units by 6.02 to get dB).

Name: Noise profile
Payload: Same format as type 2, taken at the max Doppler bin (the noise floor)

Name: Azimuth static heatmap
Payload: rangeFFTSize × numAzimuthVirtAnt × 4 B. Complex int16 pairs **imaginary first, then real**. Ordered by range bin, then antenna.

Name: Range-Doppler heatmap
Payload: rangeFFTSize × dopplerFFTSize × uint16, row-major by range bin

Name: Stats
Payload: 24 B: interFrameProcessingTime (µs), transmitOutputTime (µs), interFrameProcessingMargin (µs), interChirpProcessingMargin (µs), activeFrameCPULoad (%), interFrameCPULoad (%), each uint32

Name: Detected points side info
Payload: numDetectedObj × 4 B: `snr`, `noise`, each uint16 in **0.1 dB** units, in the same order as TLV 1

Name: Azimuth/elevation static heatmap
Enabled by `guiMonitor`: heatmap flag = 1 (AoA2D DPU, which the AOP builds use)
Payload: rangeFFTSize × **all** virtual antennas × 4 B. Same complex layout as type 4. Sent **instead of** type 4.

Name: Temperature stats
Payload: 28 B: tempReportValid (int32, 0 = valid), time (uint32, ms), then uint16 °C readings for Rx0–3, Tx0–2, PM, Dig0, Dig1
